definitions.short: some kind of nut-tree, perhaps the almond
definitions.full: H3869. luz I. לוּז noun [masculine] almond-tree, almond-wood (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic לוּזָא , almond (Löw No. 319 ), whence Arabic as loan-word (Frä 145 Lag BN 157 f. ), Ethiopic ); — Gen 30:37 (J; + לַח עַרְמוֺן לִבְנֶה, ) of rods stripped by Jacob.
